title: Author
subtitle: 「作者／作家／撰稿人」，從核心近義詞到文類作者與常用署名表達。
description: 「作者／作家／撰稿人」，從核心近義詞到文類作者與常用署名表達。

words.example: The writer of the article interviewed three experts.
words.exampleZh: 這篇文章的作者訪問了三名專家。

exercises.original: The author of the article interviewed three experts.
exercises.zh: 這篇文章的作者訪問了三名專家。
exercises.upgrade: The writer of the article interviewed three experts.

options.explanation: article 的撰寫者最自然就是 writer。
編輯可能修改文章，但不一定是原作者。
出版者負責發行，不負責必然撰寫。
narrator 是敘述聲音，通常用於故事，不適用一般文章作者。
插畫家負責圖像，不等於文章作者。

exercises.original: She is the author of three books on urban history.
exercises.zh: 她是三本城市歷史書籍的作者。
exercises.upgrade: She is the writer of three books on urban history.

options.explanation: 可以編輯書，但句子說的是三本書的作者身份。
writer of three books 與 author 高度接近。
出版書的人／公司不是撰寫者。
研究者未必是書的作者。

exercises.original: The report's author thanked the research team.
exercises.zh: 報告作者感謝研究團隊。
exercises.upgrade: The report's writer thanked the research team.

options.explanation: 可能編修報告，但不是同義。
report's writer 保留實際撰寫者意思。

words.example: The writer of the report recommends further research.
words.exampleZh: 這份報告的作者建議進一步研究。

exercises.original: The author of the report recommends further research.
exercises.zh: 報告作者建議進一步研究。
exercises.upgrade: The writer of the report recommends further research.

options.explanation: 直接說明『撰寫報告的人』，和 author of 幾乎相同。
編輯報告的人不一定提出原始內容。

exercises.original: The author of the story based it on a childhood memory.
exercises.zh: 故事作者以童年回憶為素材。
exercises.upgrade: The writer of the story based it on a childhood memory.

options.explanation: 故事敘述者可以是虛構角色，不一定是作者。

exercises.original: The book's author will speak at the library tonight.
exercises.zh: 這本書的作者今晚會在圖書館演講。
exercises.upgrade: The writer of the book will speak at the library tonight.

options.explanation: writer of the book 準確改寫 book's author。
若只是翻譯者，並非原作者。

words.example: The person who wrote the letter did not sign it.
words.exampleZh: 寫這封信的人沒有署名。

exercises.original: The author of the anonymous letter has not been identified.
exercises.zh: 匿名信的作者尚未被確認。
exercises.upgrade: The person who wrote the anonymous letter has not been identified.

options.explanation: 匿名信的 author 就是寫信的人。

exercises.original: Nobody knows who the author of the note was.
exercises.zh: 沒有人知道這張便條是誰寫的。
exercises.upgrade: Nobody knows who the person who wrote the note was.

options.explanation: 讀過便條的人可能很多。

exercises.original: The author of the email used a false name.
exercises.zh: 電郵作者使用了假名。
exercises.upgrade: The person who wrote the email used a false name.

options.explanation: 寄件者通常可能是作者，但技術上可以代寄，沒有 wrote 精準。
直接對應 author 的撰寫身份。

words.example: She is the creator of the children's book series.
words.exampleZh: 她是這套兒童讀物系列的創作者。

exercises.original: She is the author of a popular children's book series and its main characters.
exercises.zh: 她是熱門兒童書系列及主要角色的創作者。
exercises.upgrade: She is the creator of a popular children's book series and its main characters.

options.explanation: book series + main characters 強調整體原創世界的創作者身份。
編輯不一定創造角色／系列。
插畫家可能設計視覺，但不一定創造整個書系。

exercises.original: The author developed the fictional world over many years.
exercises.zh: 作者多年來逐步建立這個虛構世界。
exercises.upgrade: The creator developed the fictional world over many years.

options.explanation: 也合理，但 fictional world 的原創性讓 creator 更突出。
developed the fictional world 明確是創作整體設定。

exercises.original: The series author also designed its central concept.
exercises.zh: 這個系列的作者也設計了核心概念。
exercises.upgrade: The series creator also designed its central concept.

options.explanation: central concept 強烈支持創作者身份。
可能負責視覺，但不等於核心概念創作者。

words.example: The novelist spent five years writing the book.
words.exampleZh: 這位小說家花了五年撰寫該書。

exercises.original: The author has published six historical novels.
exercises.zh: 這位作者已出版六本歷史小說。
exercises.upgrade: The novelist has published six historical novels.

options.explanation: six historical novels 明確是小說家。

exercises.original: The book's author is best known for crime fiction.
exercises.zh: 該書作者以犯罪小說最為人熟悉。
exercises.upgrade: The novelist is best known for crime fiction.

options.explanation: crime fiction + book author 很自然。

exercises.original: As an author, she specialises in long works of fiction.
exercises.zh: 作為作家，她專門創作長篇小說。
exercises.upgrade: As a novelist, she specialises in long works of fiction.

options.explanation: 太廣，雖正確但不如 novelist 精準。
long works of fiction 就是小說。

words.example: The essayist is known for writing about memory and identity.
words.exampleZh: 這位散文家以書寫記憶與身份認同聞名。

exercises.original: The author is known for reflective essays on art and memory.
exercises.zh: 這位作者以關於藝術和記憶的反思散文聞名。
exercises.upgrade: The essayist is known for reflective essays on art and memory.

exercises.original: This author wrote a collection of personal essays.
exercises.zh: 這位作者寫了一本文個人散文集。
exercises.upgrade: This essayist wrote a collection of personal essays.

options.explanation: 專欄可有 essay 性質，但 collection of personal essays 更直接是 essayist。

exercises.original: The author combines criticism with autobiographical essays.
exercises.zh: 作者把評論與自傳式散文結合。
exercises.upgrade: The essayist combines criticism with autobiographical essays.

options.explanation: 可能寫評論，但 autobiographical essays 更貼近 essayist。

words.example: The biographer spent years studying the scientist's letters.
words.exampleZh: 這位傳記作者花了多年研究該科學家的書信。

exercises.original: The author spent ten years researching the actor's life.
exercises.zh: 這位傳記作者花了十年研究該演員的人生。
exercises.upgrade: The biographer spent ten years researching the actor's life.

options.explanation: researching the actor's life 指向傳記寫作。

exercises.original: The biography's author had access to the politician's private letters.
exercises.zh: 傳記作者可以查閱該政治人物的私人書信。
exercises.upgrade: The biographer had access to the politician's private letters.

exercises.original: The author interviewed the subject's family for the life story.
exercises.zh: 作者為撰寫傳記訪問了傳主家人。
exercises.upgrade: The biographer interviewed the subject's family for the life story.

options.explanation: 可能改編，但 life story 作者不是必然 screenwriter。
subject's family + life story 是典型傳記作者工作。

words.example: The playwright rewrote the final scene before opening night.
words.exampleZh: 劇作家在首演前重寫了最後一幕。

exercises.original: The author rewrote the final scene of the stage play.
exercises.zh: 作者重寫了舞台劇最後一幕。
exercises.upgrade: The playwright rewrote the final scene of the stage play.

exercises.original: The play's author attended the opening night.
exercises.zh: 這齣戲的劇作家出席了首演。
exercises.upgrade: The playwright attended the opening night.

exercises.original: The author is famous for political dramas written for the theatre.
exercises.zh: 作者以為劇院創作政治戲劇聞名。
exercises.upgrade: The playwright is famous for political dramas written for the theatre.

options.explanation: dramas written for theatre 是典型劇作家。

words.meaning: 編劇；電影／電視劇本作者
words.example: The screenwriter adapted the novel for television.
words.exampleZh: 編劇把小說改編成電視劇本。

exercises.original: The author adapted the novel into a film script.
exercises.zh: 作者把小說改編成電影劇本。
exercises.upgrade: The screenwriter adapted the novel into a film script.

options.explanation: film script 是最直接線索。
原小說作者不一定是改編編劇。

exercises.original: The film's author worked closely with the director on the dialogue.
exercises.zh: 電影編劇與導演密切合作修改對白。
exercises.upgrade: The film's screenwriter worked closely with the director on the dialogue.

options.explanation: film + dialogue + director 是典型編劇語境。

exercises.original: The author received an award for the television drama script.
exercises.zh: 作者憑電視劇本獲獎。
exercises.upgrade: The screenwriter received an award for the television drama script.

words.example: The columnist writes weekly about city politics.
words.exampleZh: 這位專欄作家每週撰寫城市政治評論。

exercises.original: The author writes a weekly opinion piece for the newspaper.
exercises.zh: 作者每週為報章撰寫評論專欄。
exercises.upgrade: The columnist writes a weekly opinion piece for the newspaper.

options.explanation: weekly opinion piece + newspaper 是典型專欄作家。
雖可寫評論，但固定報章專欄更精準是 columnist。

exercises.original: The newspaper author comments regularly on education policy.
exercises.zh: 這位報章專欄作者定期評論教育政策。
exercises.upgrade: The newspaper columnist comments regularly on education policy.

options.explanation: 可能寫評論，但 regularly + newspaper 更支持 columnist。

exercises.original: As an author for the magazine, she has a regular page on food and travel.
exercises.zh: 作為雜誌作者，她有固定飲食旅遊專頁。
exercises.upgrade: As a columnist for the magazine, she has a regular page on food and travel.

options.explanation: 可能，但 regular page 是專欄核心。

words.example: She is a regular contributor to the science magazine.
words.exampleZh: 她是這本科學雜誌的固定撰稿人。

exercises.original: The author writes regularly for the science magazine but is not on staff.
exercises.zh: 作者定期為科學雜誌撰稿，但不是員工。
exercises.upgrade: The contributor writes regularly for the science magazine but is not on staff.

options.explanation: regular contributions + not on staff 很符合撰稿人身份。

exercises.original: Several authors contributed chapters to the edited volume.
exercises.zh: 幾名撰稿人為這本文集撰寫章節。
exercises.upgrade: Several contributors wrote chapters for the edited volume.

options.explanation: 編者負責組織／編輯，不等於所有章節作者。
edited volume 的多位章節撰稿者自然稱 contributors。

exercises.original: The website lists each article author on its contributors page.
exercises.zh: 網站在撰稿人頁面列出每篇文章的作者。
exercises.upgrade: The website lists each article contributor on its contributors page.

options.explanation: 可能有編輯，但不是每篇文章作者。
contributors page + article writer 完全吻合。

words.example: She is the person behind the popular children's series.
words.exampleZh: 她是這套熱門兒童系列背後的創作者。

exercises.original: She is the author of the popular fantasy series.
exercises.zh: 她是這套熱門奇幻系列背後的創作者。
exercises.upgrade: She is the person behind the popular fantasy series.

options.explanation: idiomatic 地表示整個系列背後的創作人物。
只負責圖像時不等於整體作者。

exercises.original: The documentary interviews the author behind the bestselling book.
exercises.zh: 紀錄片訪問暢銷書背後的作者。
exercises.upgrade: The documentary interviews the person behind the bestselling book.

options.explanation: 可能有出版人，但不等於作者。

exercises.original: Readers were eager to meet the author behind the series.
exercises.zh: 讀者很想見到這個系列幕後創作者。
exercises.upgrade: Readers were eager to meet the person behind the series.

options.explanation: readers want to meet creator，語氣自然。
可能參與，但不一定是 author。

words.meaning: 文字高手；善於寫作的人
words.example: The author is a gifted wordsmith with a sharp sense of humour.
words.exampleZh: 這位作者是文字功力出眾、幽默感敏銳的寫作高手。

exercises.original: The author is admired for elegant, witty prose.
exercises.zh: 這位作者因優雅而機智的文筆受到欣賞。
exercises.upgrade: The wordsmith is admired for elegant, witty prose.

options.explanation: elegant, witty prose 明確是在讚賞文字技巧。
可能也有文筆，但原句是作者身份。
編輯不等於文體創作者。

exercises.original: Critics describe the author as a master of precise language.
exercises.zh: 評論家形容這位作者是精準文字的大師。
exercises.upgrade: Critics describe the wordsmith as a master of precise language.

options.explanation: 編輯也重視文字，但 master of precise language 在此評價作者文筆。
正是『文字高手』的評價性表達。

exercises.original: The author can turn ordinary events into vivid prose.
exercises.zh: 這位作者能把平凡事件寫成生動文字。
exercises.upgrade: The wordsmith can turn ordinary events into vivid prose.

options.explanation: turn events into vivid prose 強調寫作技巧。

words.example: The novel is by a young Canadian writer.
words.exampleZh: 這本小說由一位年輕加拿大作家撰寫。

exercises.original: The book's author is Maya Chen.
exercises.zh: 這本書的作者是 Maya Chen。
exercises.upgrade: The book is by Maya Chen.

options.explanation: 出版語境中 by + 人名是最標準作者署名結構。
表示編輯者，不等於作者。

exercises.original: The article's author is a university researcher.
exercises.zh: 這篇文章由一名大學研究員撰寫。
exercises.upgrade: The article is by a university researcher.

options.explanation: 說的是出版機構／出版者。

exercises.original: The report's author is Dr Patel.
exercises.zh: 這份報告由 Patel 博士撰寫。
exercises.upgrade: The report is by Dr Patel.

options.explanation: report by Dr Patel 是標準作者標示。

falseSynonyms.zh: 編輯不等於作者 editor 負責修改、整理或選編文字；author 負責創作內容。有人可以同時是作者和編輯，但角色不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An editor revises or organises a text; an author writes it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 出版者不等於作者 publisher 負責出版、發行或商業運作，不等於撰寫作品。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A publisher releases a book; the author writes it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 敘述者不等於作者 narrator 是故事內講述故事的聲音或角色；不一定等於真實作者。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The narrator may be fictional even though the author is real.

falseSynonyms.zh: 角色不等於作者 character 是作品中的人物；author 是作品外的創作者。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A character exists inside the story; the author creates the story.

falseSynonyms.zh: 讀者不等於作者 reader 是閱讀作品的人，角色與作者相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The reader receives the text; the author produces it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 研究者不一定等於作者 researcher 進行研究；只有實際撰寫並署名作品時才是 author。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A researcher may contribute data without being the author of the final paper.

falseSynonyms.zh: 插畫家不等於文字作者 illustrator 負責圖像；author 通常負責文字。兒童書中兩者經常是不同的人。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The illustrator creates the pictures; the author writes the text.

falseSynonyms.zh: 翻譯者不等於原作者 translator 把作品轉換成另一種語言；原始 author 仍是原作創作者。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A translator rewrites a text in another language but is not its original author.
